title: Type an exact time with a wall-time hint
body:
The OpenSpec change `add-wall-time-input-with-hint` is already prepared in `openspec/changes/add-wall-time-input-with-hint/`. Do not create a new change.

**specify:** run the `openspec-propose` procedure against this existing change. It was written before its dependencies were implemented: re-check every claim about the code against the current `main` (`HereEntryRow`, the shared card layout block, the legacy zone shim, and whether the shim covers `resolveWallClock`), and update the artifacts. Keep the scope and decisions. Leave it the only active change.

Depends on: `support-legacy-ios-12-safari`, `set-home-location-and-show-differences`, `show-here-entry-for-device-time` (all archived).

Goal: README MVP feature 5, "type a time in any location". The large time on a card or on the Here entry becomes a wall-time input.

Decided:
- Text field, `inputmode="numeric"`, not `<input type="time">`. Lenient 24-hour parsing: `9`, `930`, `9:30`, `09.30`, `0930`. Only `parseWallTimeInput` (presenter) parses; the model checks only the `HH:MM` command shape (`INVALID_TIME`).
- The date is the local date the row shows when the input opens. If the instant leaves the reference day, the date bar follows it.
- `SET_WALL_TIME { target, time, date }` resolves through `resolveWallClock` (`compatible`). `target` is a location or the Here entry. Status and requested time reuse the existing `PINNED` fields; only `wallTimeTarget` is new.
- Wall-time hint in that row on GAP / AMBIGUOUS, with `UTC−4` and never `GMT`. It lasts until the next change of the moment. Only one wall-clock note shows at a time: a GAP from a date change stays the gap note in the date bar.
- If the model rejects the input (location removed in another tab), the field closes silently. Invalid text keeps the field open with an error.
- The time button's accessible name includes the city and the time («Ввести время — Москва, 10:30»). It opens on click, so it works without Pointer Events.
- Q4 in `docs/architecture/open-questions.md` is updated: typing a time works for listed locations and for the Here entry.
- Risk: if the legacy zone shim does not cover `PlainDateTime#toZonedDateTime`, fix the shim, not `resolveWallClock` (test: `Europe/Kyiv` on an engine that accepts only `Europe/Kiev`).

report.question: The task says support-legacy-ios-12-safari, set-home-location-and-show-differences and show-here-entry-for-device-time are archived and implemented on main, but in this working copy (HEAD b7796fc, based on d59c2d5 'New specs 2026 10 29') all three are still ACTIVE under openspec/changes/ and none of their code exists: no HereEntryRow, no legacy zone shim, no home-location code in packages/client/src (resolveWallClock exists only in model/wallClock.ts). So the code claims cannot be re-checked against implemented dependencies, and the 'exactly one active change' verify check cannot pass without editing outside add-wall-time-input-with-hint/, which this stage forbids. How should I proceed?
options: Rebase this task branch onto a main where the three dependencies are implemented and archived, then rerun the specify stage

Let the specify stage archive the three dependency changes and rewrite add-wall-time-input-with-hint against the code as it is now (dependencies not implemented), listing the missing pieces as prerequisites
Leave the artifacts unchanged and postpone this task until the dependencies are implemented
